card.name: Mixed: digit 1 and place/people words
card.fires_on: Responds to a leading digit 1 in years or densities, and to place or settlement words such as state, areas, colonists and Israelites in geography or history text.

modes.label: Leading digit 1
modes.description: The digit 1 starting a year or number, just before the next digits.
modes.example: He met with Pope John Paul II in 1980 and also later in 1982, 1986, <<1>>988, 199

modes.description: Words like state, areas, settlement or colonists in geographic or historical passages.

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: Part of a longer word or hyphenated term, such as colon before ists, or the hyphen in pan-Indian.
